en: The postcard shows a panoramic, black-and-white view of a small European town situated in a rural landscape. The foreground contains fields, trees, and walking paths, while the background depicts a dense cluster of typical early-20th-century buildings. Notable is a church with a tall steeple dominating the town's skyline. In the top left, there is red printed text reading 'Frankenberg i. Sa.'.
